risks.risk: Camera may not power on or record video/photo
risks.proof: Video clip showing the camera turning on, screen lighting up, and recording a short video or taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens or internal components may be damaged or dirty
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens surface and a photo of the camera's screen showing a live view or sample photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential lens or sensor issues

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery compartment with battery inserted, or a photo of the charger and battery if included.

risks.risk: Camera may have physical damage not visible in front view (e.g., cracked screen, broken buttons)
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the camera showing the screen and buttons, and side/top views showing ports and switches.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the camera showing the screen and buttons.
Photo of the side and top of the camera showing ports, switches, and battery compartment.
Video clip showing the camera turning on and recording a short video.
Photo of the battery and charger if included.
response.reason: The camera's identity and key features are supported by the photos, but critical functional and physical aspects (screen, buttons, internal condition, battery, charger) are not visible. Without proof of working condition and full physical state, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be assessed as potentially non-functional or damaged.
